stage0059_03:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$正太郎$$
「It's been a while since we got back to Japan」

stage0059_03:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Seriously.
　We were invited to a party on the
　$$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$, but ended up in space...」

stage0059_03:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Thanks to that, summer vacation's basically over」

stage0059_03:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$甲児$$
「And as always, the homework's untouched...」

stage0059_03:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$スズネ$$
「$$ワッ太$$...
　I kept telling you, just a little
　homework each day would be fine...」

stage0059_03:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Easy for you to say, but
　it's been one shock and crisis after another,
　I just couldn't get in the mood」

stage0059_03:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$正太郎$$
「All I have left is my book report」

stage0059_03:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$正太郎$$
「What are you talking about.
　I told you so many times, let's do our
　homework together, but you never did it」

stage0059_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Just a little... can I see your homework?
　Just Japanese, math, science and social studies」

stage0059_03:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「J-just kidding, Miss $$スズネ$$!
　Don't make that scary face」

stage0059_03:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Some jokes are fine to make, and some aren't!」

stage0059_03:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$スズネ$$
「That's it, I've decided.
　From today until the last day of summer
　break, I'll watch over your homework myself!」

stage0059_03:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$スズネ$$
「I promised Miss $$美重子$$ at the elementary
　school! Just this once, I'll be tough on you!」

stage0059_03:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$n
（Just listen to her, $$ワッ太$$.
　At this rate, the terrifying Miss $$スズネ$$
　is going to come out again）

stage0059_03:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$正太郎$$
「For $$ワッ太$$, homework seems like a
　tougher enemy than $$エタニティ・フラット$$ or $$バアル$$」

stage0059_03:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$n
「Better than shrinking back in fear.
　Though I'll face humanity's crises head-on too」

stage0059_03:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Let's do this, $$ワッ太$$.
　I'll teach you math and science」

stage0059_03:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$甲児$$
「You sure you've got time for that?」

stage0059_03:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$かなめ$$
「It was way too huge to just call it a resort,
　but I did get to enjoy my summer.
　Now I'm just taking it easy」

stage0059_03:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$n
「$$宗介$$'s off on a mission elsewhere.
　Chidori should get some peace and quiet」

stage0059_03:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Besides, if I started listing worries,
　I'd have a whole world's worth」

stage0059_03:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$さやか$$
「Though this isn't really a laughing matter」

stage0059_03:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$n
「Thanks for giving up your summer
　to help us, Chidori」

stage0059_03:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$かなめ$$
「In spirit, I'm part of $c too」

stage0059_03:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Anyway, for the rest of summer I'll help
　$$ワッ太$$ while taking care of the favor
　$$テッサ$$ asked me for」

stage0059_03:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$かなめ$$
「She wants advice on $$ミスリル$$ secrets.
　Showing me that stuff is pointless...」

stage0059_03:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$n
（$$宗介$$ seemed off when we parted ways...
　Maybe Chidori's picked up on it too...）

stage0059_03:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$赤木$$
「The students are still on summer break, huh」

stage0059_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$中原$$
「Not so long ago,
　we used to be just like that...」

stage0059_03:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$入江$$
「Calling something from five or six years
　ago 'not so long ago' is a bit much...」

stage0059_03:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$中原$$
「I-$$入江$$... please don't bring up my age...!」

stage0059_03:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$谷川$$
「Still, must be nice.
　Students get over a month of summer break」

stage0059_03:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$大山$$
「Working folks get a week if we're lucky」

stage0059_03:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$木下$$
「Japanese salarymen work way too much.
　Now that we've got the Earth Federation,
　we need to get with the times globally!」

stage0059_03:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$柿小路$$
「$$木下$$! What are you saying!
　It's far better than having
　nothing to do and too much free time!」

stage0059_03:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$柿小路$$
「It's because you, whose job is to bring in
　work, keep talking like that, that our company's
　faced crisis after crisis after crisis!」

stage0059_03:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$青山$$
「Are you all right, Director $$柿小路$$...!」

stage0059_03:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$柿小路$$
「N-no need to worry.
　It's just my old stomach trouble acting up...」

stage0059_03:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$厚井$$
「It's been one shock after another lately.
　No wonder」

stage0059_03:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$柿小路$$
「It's a relief we made it back to Japan.
　I'll go see my regular doctor today」

stage0059_03:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$柿小路$$
「N-no, I'm fine, $$青山$$!
　I'm healthy enough to see a doctor alone!」

stage0059_03:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$赤木$$
「It's been a while since we've had Japan,
　and a break too. Let's enjoy it」

stage0059_03:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$いぶき$$
「I'm going back to my parents' place...」

stage0059_03:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$入江$$
「Sounds like a husband whose wife ran off, just from listening」

stage0059_03:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$郁絵$$
「But $$いぶき$$... she did seem off」

stage0059_03:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$佐伯$$
「Earlier, $$桃井$$ argued with someone on the phone...」

stage0059_03:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$大山$$
「What does that have to do with $$いぶき$$?」

stage0059_03:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$佐伯$$
「And the person she was arguing with
　seems to have been $$桃井$$'s father...」

stage0059_03:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$青山$$
「Obviously the 'father' here isn't
　Dr. 《$$桜田栄二郎$$》, right?」

stage0059_03:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$赤木$$
「Ah, right...
　Must mean her mom's new husband, her stepfather」

stage0059_03:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$谷川$$
「Now every mystery is solved...!
　$$いぶき$$ doesn't want to face that father,
　that's why she's been so down!」

stage0059_03:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$佐伯$$
「That could be it...
　It seems $$桃井$$'s father was against her
　piloting $$ダイ・ガード$$ too」

stage0059_03:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
Secretary
「$$桃井$$ has stepped out on business
　at the moment, so please wait a bit longer」

stage0059_03:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「Still, I was surprised.
　So $$いぶき$$'s father turns out
　to be the dean of a university hospital」

stage0059_03:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「I heard he was a doctor, but
　he's actually a really big deal」

stage0059_03:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$赤木$$
「But he's a stubborn dad, blind to $$いぶき$$'s work」

stage0059_03:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「So we're gonna win her dad over,
　so $$いぶき$$ can work without worry」

stage0059_03:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$赤木$$
「Exactly.
　If $$いぶき$$ keeps piling up stress like this,
　it'll get in the way of $c's work too」

stage0059_03:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$木下$$
「Ours is a grave mission indeed」

stage0059_03:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Why am I a member of
　this grave mission, though...」

stage0059_03:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$木下$$
「$$シンジ$$'s been looked after by
　$$いぶき$$ too. That's the angle we'll use」

stage0059_03:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$木下$$
「The pitch: liked by coworkers and
　rivals, popular from kids to teens,
　and kind to otherworld drifters. A super OL...!」

stage0059_03:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$シンジ$$
（That's laying it on so thick it sounds fishy...）

stage0059_03:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「Let's do our best, $$シンジ$$.
　I'll back you up too」

stage0059_03:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「Being that half-hearted won't do!
　This calls for effort and guts!」

stage0059_03:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$木下$$
「To save $$いぶき$$ from crisis, a mighty duo is born!」

stage0059_03:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$n
（Don't worry, $$シンジ$$.
　If it comes to that, I'll stop them myself）

stage0059_03:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$シンジ$$
（Must be tough for you too, $n）

stage0059_03:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$n
（With $$アルト$$ up in space right now,
　I'll protect the Volunteer Club myself...!）

stage0059_03:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「Come on, you too, $n!
　Making that sour face will just put them on guard」

stage0059_03:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$n
「... This is how it always goes.」

stage0059_03:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$木下$$
「But you're really fired up, $$ノリコ$$.」

stage0059_03:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「I guess I've carried on my papa's...
　my father's will, fighting Space Monsters too.」

stage0059_03:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「That's why I can't just leave $$いぶき$$ alone.」

stage0059_03:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「I inherited the Trider and Takeo
　General Company from my old man too.
　So I'm butting into this kind of talk.」

stage0059_03:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$木下$$
「With your passion, plus a push from
　my colleague $$赤木$$ and my sales pitch,
　it's unstoppable... Getter with a Tomahawk!」

stage0059_03:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$シンジ$$
（There really are all kinds of fathers...）

stage0059_03:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$桃井$$
「My apologies for keeping you waiting.」

stage0059_03:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$木下$$
「No... thank you for taking the
　time out of your busy schedule
　to see us.」

stage0059_03:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$桃井$$
「Not at all...
　Colleagues of my daughter's have
　gone out of their way to come here.」

stage0059_03:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$ノリコ$$
（Huh, he's a lot more of a gentleman than I imagined...）

stage0059_03:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$シンジ$$
（Telling me that now, of all times...）

stage0059_03:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$桃井$$
「So... what brings you here today?
　Is there some problem with $$いぶき$$...?」

stage0059_03:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$赤木$$
「No... there's no problem with $$いぶき$$ at all.」

stage0059_03:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$木下$$
「Quite the opposite. She's the idol of
　our $c... no, our queen... our goddess, even!」

stage0059_03:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「We came here to give whoever's
　bothering $$いぶき$$ a piece of our minds.」

stage0059_03:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$桃井$$
「What do you mean by that?」

stage0059_03:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$赤木$$
「I'll say it plainly, $$桃井$$.
　If you keep getting in the way of
　$$いぶき$$'s work, we'll have to act.」

stage0059_03:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$桃井$$
「... What are you talking about?」

stage0059_03:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$いぶき$$
「Wha...! $$赤木$$ and the others went to
　protest at my father's hospital!?」

stage0059_03:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$青山$$
「We did try to stop them, since it's
　someone else's family matter, but...」

stage0059_03:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$大山$$
「$$赤木$$... he wanted your dad to
　understand $$いぶき$$, and got carried away...」

stage0059_03:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$$いぶき$$
「Honestly...
　Same as always, not thinking ahead...」

stage0059_03:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$正太郎$$
「I'm sorry, $$いぶき$$...
　If only we'd stopped $$ワッ太$$...」

stage0059_03:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$いぶき$$
「It's fine, $$正太郎$$.
　My dad won't lose that easily.」

stage0059_03:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$桃井$$
「... I see.
　So you're saying that I'm the one
　sapping $$いぶき$$'s motivation.」

stage0059_03:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$赤木$$
「That's right.
　Please, just accept $$いぶき$$ for who she is!」

stage0059_03:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$$赤木$$
「$$いぶき$$'s working her hardest too,
　to protect the peace!」

stage0059_03:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$桃井$$
「...Would you deny a parent the right to worry?」

stage0059_03:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$桃井$$
「Then let me have my say as well.」

stage0059_03:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$桃井$$
「I hear you pilot $$ダイ・ガード$$, but that
　you always ignore the orders of your
　navigator $$いぶき$$ and charge in anyway.」

stage0059_03:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$桃井$$
「Being the mood-maker is a fine thing,
　but as a young man on Takeo General
　Company's staff, get it together more.」

stage0059_03:r_7c0d3c51f9a11ca0.text:
$$桃井$$
「You can't keep leaning on Director
　$$柿小路$$ and Managing Director $$厚井$$ forever.」

stage0059_03:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$桃井$$
「Have you finished your summer homework?」

stage0059_03:r_f228ae702350849b.text:
$$桃井$$
「I know being President is hard work,
　but don't forget your duty as a student.」

stage0059_03:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$桃井$$
「I haven't even said anything yet...
　If you don't fix that timid streak,
　you'll make a fatal mistake someday.」

stage0059_03:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$$桃井$$
「Sometimes a person must show a strong
　will. What good are you like that then?」

stage0059_03:r_4c92652c9b1adf6f.text:
$$シンジ$$
（So this is what it's like... to be scolded by a father.）

stage0059_03:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$桃井$$
「Looks like you got dragged along with them too.」

stage0059_03:r_9dc59affd40f32fc.text:
$n
「No, I came of my own will.」

stage0059_03:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
$n
「My father retrained me when I was
　hopeless, and taught me how to live.」

stage0059_03:r_d36072babd12aeb4.text:
$n
「That's why I wanted to help $$いぶき$$,
　since she has some friction
　with her own father.」

stage0059_03:r_09ee921a85025fd3.text:
$$桃井$$
「You seem to have grown a good deal.」

stage0059_03:r_62ecd978c667bd29.text:
$$桃井$$
「You've only just arrived in this world,
　so it must be tough, but do your best.」

stage0059_03:r_b2aab8873350ea1f.text:
$$桃井$$
「I hear you're a battle-hardened warrior.
　Quite admirable, for one so young.」

stage0059_03:r_2c7af4c55d8ac938.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「N-no, not at all...!
　I just really love robot anime and
　tokusatsu, and I flunked out at school...」

stage0059_03:r_d584d4b5af55b1cf.text:
$n
「I thought you were a battle-hardened warrior...」

stage0059_03:r_db0ee69ece206fcd.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「That's just like $$赤木$$, isn't it!」

stage0059_03:r_422861e0b8d77d0c.text:
$$赤木$$
「Never mind school, but when it comes
　to loving robot anime, I won't lose either.」

stage0059_03:r_ef16bcaa2b0e0c45.text:
$$赤木$$
「I'll show you my prized robot anime
　collection sometime.」

stage0059_03:r_7980fd37141d88d0.text:
$$木下$$
「Oh ho! This will only deepen the bond
　of our strongest duo even further!」

stage0059_03:r_ac21212c36d2b9ad.text:
$$桃井$$
「Mm, mm...
　It's wonderful, pushing each other to grow.」

stage0059_03:r_a8118b2e37aa1382.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「What's going on!?
　How do you know so much
　about $c!」

stage0059_03:r_017a56991b7b8ca4.text:
$n
「Even about $$ノリコ$$, who just joined us...」

stage0059_03:r_ad3e1db3419665fb.text:
$$木下$$
「Wh-what do we do, $$赤木$$!?
　We're at a total disadvantage!」

stage0059_03:r_0149e3a5f2e5ef78.text:
$$赤木$$
「What do we do, you ask... I don't know...」

stage0059_03:r_bdc546b199c80996.text:
$$赤木$$
「Excuse me for a moment...!
　I need to take this call!」

stage0059_03:r_22c8caf8c08c5119.text:
$$桃井$$
「Hmm... at least you know basic manners.」

stage0059_03:r_96f156e19b53fc09.text:
$$大杉$$
「$$赤木$$... bring everyone back right away.
　A Mechanical Beast Army is closing on Odaiba.」

stage0059_03:r_3ac462d37e5893ff.text:
Doctor
「We were worried, when you insisted
　on staying at the hospital to the end.」

stage0059_03:r_d38be46e6cd7a5e5.text:
Doctor
「Just like the daughter you always talk about.」

stage0059_03:r_3fe2078328753c16.text:
$$桃井$$
「... No good.
　Seems that girl's rubbed off on me too.」

stage0059_03:r_c66844158d1ce600.text:
$$青山$$
「Sounds like her dad's a real good man.」

stage0059_03:r_d037ecbc1e348dc9.text:
$$大山$$
「Yeah.
　The younger staff seem to respect him too.」

stage0059_03:r_9ca55ea7feca954a.text:
$$いぶき$$
「Honestly...
　Charging in without checking facts first is exactly how this happens.」

stage0059_03:r_554ae12c4c170253.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「But, $$いぶき$$...
　didn't your dad oppose you
　piloting $$ダイ・ガード$$!」

stage0059_03:r_aa5d235c78ebe19f.text:
$$いぶき$$
「That was during the $$破界事変$$.
　Lately he understands my work better.」

stage0059_03:r_0b3b19cddb871f90.text:
$$赤木$$
「Eh... but... $$佐伯$$ said he saw you
　fighting with him on the phone...」

stage0059_03:r_304e98dac43c9333.text:
$$いぶき$$
「Well, we're family.
　Of course we fight sometimes.」

stage0059_03:r_b740d817a14afd3a.text:
$$いぶき$$
「It's not like we fight because we hate
　each other. He's just overprotective, is all...」

stage0059_03:r_40e4c010d1b35b4c.text:
$$赤木$$
「So $$佐伯$$ just jumped to conclusions, huh.」

stage0059_03:r_c33abf00683a32bc.text:
$$佐伯$$
「What are you talking about!
　That's on $$赤木$$'s end, isn't it!」

stage0059_03:r_3036adce91d1f4a8.text:
$$赤木$$
「Anyway, if you're always playing the
　cool commander, you could've stopped us!」

stage0059_03:r_019293cb83599509.text:
$$佐伯$$
「I know full well that warning
　$$赤木$$ never does any good.」

stage0059_03:r_c9016e3ab05470b0.text:
$$柿小路$$
「President, $$赤木$$, $$木下$$, $$シンジ$$, $$ノリコ$$,
　you too, $n. Everyone, listen up.」

stage0059_03:r_a684e6cea428e518.text:
$$柿小路$$
「Not trying to understand others,
　and acting on your own assumptions -
　you've learned how dangerous and rude that is.」

stage0059_03:r_b4fa30f33e84207f.text:
$$柿小路$$
「Look at Dr. $$桃井$$.
　There are plenty of people out there,
　working hard where we never even see it.」

stage0059_03:r_9133b7e0b34de48f.text:
$$柿小路$$
「We fight to protect the happiness
　and peace of people just like him.
　Never forget that, you hear?」

stage0059_03:r_a84ab0c3c1ba44d4.text:
$$木下$$
「Still, I don't quite get it...
　So then, why was $$いぶき$$ so reluctant
　to go home in the first place?」

stage0059_03:r_83a9e41e15444c69.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Speaking of not knowing things,
　how did $$いぶき$$'s dad...
　know so much about us?」

stage0059_03:r_09227dec2bd6f4d8.text:
$$いぶき$$
「That's a mystery to me too.
　I wasn't exactly keeping him updated either...」

stage0059_03:r_7b3a37f5039eb1f6.text:
$$赤木$$
「Well, it's fine either way.
　Anyway, case closed for now.」

stage0059_03:r_a7ce9f908380694c.text:
$$シンジ$$
「...Even if you're not related by blood,
　can you still call someone 'Dad'?」

stage0059_03:r_0835ec3fff318aff.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I'm sorry...
　Just forget I said that.」

stage0059_03:r_c32efc7394910997.text:
$$いぶき$$
「You can.
　Because we became a family, after all.」

stage0059_03:r_bc0273c6ae91c929.text:
$$いぶき$$
「Blood ties don't matter.
　If you both choose to become family, you can.」

stage0059_03:r_8deea7c70d7a76e7.text:
$$いぶき$$
「So, $$シンジ$$...
　try taking a step forward.」

stage0059_03:r_5d8b67b5bd8ce190.text:
$$赤木$$
「$$いぶき$$'s right.
　Just thinking it won't get your feelings across.」

stage0059_03:r_6ccd85652ef4ccf1.text:
$$アスカ$$
「What... why are you grinning like that?」

stage0059_03:r_1f438885dbc1359e.text:
$n
「You should learn a thing or two from $$シンジ$$.」

stage0059_03:r_2e59226caa35f6e5.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Not something I want to hear
　from one of the Silent Five.」

stage0059_03:r_78d3b2a75e38d6f7.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Payback for telling me to look up to 'Daddy's Boy'.」

stage0059_03:r_8d461de418389bf8.text:
$$シンジ$$
「You seem to be having fun, Shikinami.」

stage0059_03:r_5cb2acefa1e7c7fb.text:
$$アスカ$$
「How is this supposed to look like fun to you?!」

stage0059_03:r_59ce7fd9524ec8be.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Really?
　You looked like you were laughing too, Shikinami.」

stage0059_03:r_33f67c683bda9203.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Are you an idiot!?
　Where were you even looking!」

stage0059_03:r_6be0d6139fac197c.text:
$$いぶき$$
「Heh... and here he'd just taken a step forward.」

stage0059_03:r_df899b8031b4ca06.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Huh... come to think of it, where's the Director?」

stage0059_03:r_c5d048c7db7cac75.text:
$$郁絵$$
「He did mention he was heading to the hospital again.」

stage0059_03:r_308e8ac66b1141ef.text:
$$いぶき$$
「I wonder if his stomach's acting up again...」

stage0059_03:r_64f25294d71a5d55.text:
$n
（I see...
　I'm starting to get the picture.）

stage0059_03:r_34a510533cb8a9f5.text:
$$桃井$$
「What's wrong, $$柿小路$$?
　Is your stomach acting up again?」

stage0059_03:r_1afedc9fa466f321.text:
$$柿小路$$
「No, no... thanks to you, Dr. $$桃井$$,
　that's not a problem anymore.」

stage0059_03:r_9547b3241808695f.text:
$$桃井$$
「No, no... the thanks are all mine,
　you've told me so much about
　$$いぶき$$'s situation. It's been a huge help.」

stage0059_03:r_32b2a8ce24deeb9f.text:
$$桃井$$
「That even let me fend off $$赤木$$ and his friends.」

stage0059_03:r_c7ef92060bb8199d.text:
$$柿小路$$
「That's just it, Dr. $$桃井$$.
　Our young people, our own President included,
　have caused you real trouble. Truly, I'm sorry.」

stage0059_03:r_1be6d12f616f04e4.text:
$$桃井$$
「Please, don't worry about it.
　I was glad to get the chance
　to actually meet them myself.」

stage0059_03:r_80f948aeaed93de8.text:
$$桃井$$
「Could it be, because of that $$赤木$$ fellow,
　that $$いぶき$$'s refusing the matchmaking?」

stage0059_03:r_0d24e9726dcc79f9.text:
$$柿小路$$
「Ah... that's not it at all.
　Those two are just colleagues.」

stage0059_03:r_da648116badd491a.text:
$$柿小路$$
「But pushing $$いぶき$$ toward any more
　matchmaking might not be wise...」

stage0059_03:r_4e91ccecf1dd0f66.text:
$$桃井$$
「So it seems.
　She seems to want to decide her own path in life.」

stage0059_03:r_668b7114a3ac1d77.text:
$$桃井$$
「That's probably the influence of
　Public Relations Section 2 and everyone at $c.」

stage0059_03:r_ce68dd10a19e01ea.text:
$$桃井$$
「Well then, $$柿小路$$... your stomach's
　settled down now, so how about tonight?」

stage0059_03:r_13ce8d4e4858b193.text:
$$柿小路$$
「I'd be glad to join you.
　Over a drink, let's talk long into the night
　about $$いぶき$$ and the future of Earth.」

stage0059_03:r_afa513b4815df4c9.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well fought, Master $$ノリコ$$, Master $$さやか$$.」

stage0059_03:r_e62eb587b8d34cb9.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「W-what's wrong...!?
　I only meant to thank you for your hard work...」

stage0059_03:r_d72cc2c0739c9088.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「Sorry, $$ＡＧ$$.
　We just got harassed a bit,
　so we're a little on edge.」

stage0059_03:r_ecf4e1c8c0f8d2d7.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah, that would be $$ブロッケン伯爵$$.
　My, what a splendid gentleman he is.」

stage0059_03:r_e793fc3ce3a0c28d.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Thanks to his contact with Master $$ノリコ$$
　and Master $$さやか$$, a Z-Chip was born.」

stage0059_03:r_2be6c657d0e12c4b.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The amount... 50Z!
　I'll add this to the squad's stock.」

stage0059_03:r_7569f965fff4d791.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah... but if it's just about making Z-Chips,
　it needn't be $$ブロッケン伯爵$$ specifically, right?」

stage0059_03:r_b43bdba9393d4d68.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then let this humble $$ＡＧ$$ prank you two instead...」

stage0059_03:r_1a4dc288e81719ee.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well fought, Master $$いぶき$$.
　Instead of killing time in a place like this,
　why not go on home?」

stage0059_03:r_b8902c992035da79.text:
$$いぶき$$
「Well, it's just...
　I don't feel like going home tonight.」

stage0059_03:r_df10ad0a71c307da.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ooh... what a moving line.
　A pity I'm just a robot.」

stage0059_03:r_9293c52555ba1457.text:
$$いぶき$$
「Guess I won't get bored staying here.」

stage0059_03:r_6c41647935e2574a.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well... rather than a matchmaking date
　with some strange man, a robot's easier.」

stage0059_03:r_51ce1d8caa34c103.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well, you know...
　a dimensional trader has to gather intel too.」

stage0059_03:r_d00313056b19262c.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「By the way, here's one more juicy tidbit.
　Your father's with Master $$柿小路$$ right now,
　enjoying themselves at a bar in Shimbashi.」

stage0059_03:r_d41f1e36365baa6f.text:
$$いぶき$$
「Why would Dad and the Director be together...?」

stage0059_03:r_2c37dd5b8f919a88.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That's something you should ask him yourself.
　You are his child, after all.」

stage0059_03:r_53f5199f05a9aad8.text:
$$いぶき$$
「...You're right.
　I played the big sister for $$シンジ$$,
　so I should speak my own feelings too.」

stage0059_03:r_c6937f14a8985c35.text:
$$いぶき$$
「While I'm at it,
　I'll turn down the matchmaking again, for good.」

stage0059_03:r_07513334490fbdf9.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I do think that's for the best.
　For the sake of $c's male members too.」

stage0059_03:r_f5507082e5c31362.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now then, let's give it our all tonight too!」
